summary.zh: 为 Caddy 后的移动端 HTTPS 增加可信代理安全上下文与 Secure 会话 cookie，同时拒绝直接客户端伪造 X-Forwarded-Proto。
summary.en: Adds trusted reverse-proxy HTTPS context and Secure session cookies for Mobile behind Caddy while rejecting direct X-Forwarded-Proto spoofing.

title.zh: 移动端 HTTPS 可信代理与 Secure cookie
title.en: Trusted Mobile HTTPS proxy and Secure cookies

summary.zh: 仅当上游 socket peer 为 loopback 时才信任单值 X-Forwarded-Proto: https；HANA_SECURE_COOKIES=1 为 Web 会话签发与清除添加 Secure，插件资产会话复用同一可信安全上下文。直接 LAN/公网客户端即使伪造该 header 也不会被视为 HTTPS。
summary.en: Trust a single X-Forwarded-Proto: https value only when the immediate socket peer is loopback. HANA_SECURE_COOKIES=1 adds Secure to issued and cleared web-session cookies, and plugin asset sessions reuse the same trusted security context. Direct LAN/public clients cannot self-assert HTTPS with that header.

sources.title: fix(server): trust loopback HTTPS proxy context
